title: Supply Chain Operations Lead
description_plain:
Direct our primary automotive logistics hub, oversee SAP S/4HANA supply chain workflows, manage 3PL carrier contracts, and ensure on-time delivery metrics.

Requirements:
- 5+ years leading warehouse operations, freight procurement, and 3PL vendor performance.
- Hands-on operational mastery of SAP ERP / S/4HANA supply chain modules.

mandatory_constraints: On-site presence in Chennai logistics hub
